verdict.rationale: DPMA documents a 'classical' paper-based filing route by mail or fax alongside e-filing (dpma-docs-15) and publishes paper forms for national trade mark applications (dpma-docs-7), so an offline fallback rail exists and has forms. The evidence does not show the exact postal addresses or fax numbers, and paper forms are only evidenced for trade marks. Missing for 10: exact mailing addresses and fax numbers, evidence of paper forms for patents/designs/utility models, explicit framing as a fallback when online systems are unavailable.
